ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and campus camera monitoring platform designed for industrial and educational land compliance, providing real-time anomaly detection and alert dispatching.
ideas.title: KPRIET Campus Autonomous Surveillance & Safety System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying computer vision and geospatial anomaly detection to a physical campus setting, which directly appeals to judges from an engineering and AI/ML department.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent dietary management and meal recommendation platform tailored for college hostels, analyzing student nutritional intake and suggesting balanced meal plans from campus mess menus.
ideas.title: SmartMess AI Nutrition & Health Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the winning execution of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant, targeting a hyper-local pain point (campus food and student health) that judges immediately understand and appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics tool that uses statistical modeling and machine learning to forecast campus security incidents, resource bottlenecks, and facility maintenance needs based on historical operational data.
ideas.title: CampusGuard AI Incident Forecasting Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced statistical forecasting (similar to the Apart Research winning project) rather than just a basic wrapper, showing genuine technical depth in a 24-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent video processing platform that turns unstructured recorded lectures and institutional webinars into searchable, transcribed, and summarized knowledge bases.
ideas.title: AcademiVideo: AI Lecture Intelligence Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning strategy of LibrAI by solving a massive unstructured data problem that is universally relevant to an educational institution hosting the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered client acquisition and trust verification engine tailored for university health centers and campus medical clinics to streamline patient onboarding and triage.
ideas.title: CampusTrust AI Patient & Clinic Intake Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact rapid-prototype and domain-specific workflow seen in Global-Smile, focusing heavily on a polished UI and practical real-world conversion utility.
